name: D&B Risk Analytics
description: Dun & Bradstreet empowers teams to execute risk workflows such as KYC/KYB, entity resolution, screening, alert triage, and more using relationship-aware business context from the D&B Commercial Graph™. Verified risk data, anchored in the global standard D‑U‑N‑S® Number business identifier, and policy-driven logic provide the foundation for consistent decisioning across systems of record and scalable risk operations in regulated environments.

_published_faq.name: How do I add D&B Risk Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add D&B Risk Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://agents.riskanalytics.dnb.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the D&B Risk Analytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: D&B Risk Analytics lists 33 MCP tools, including RAPortfolioTool, RASearchTool, RAOverviewTool, RAScoreAndRAtingsTool, RACompositeRiskScorecardTool, RAFinancialTool, RACorporateLinkageTool, RAUltimateBeneficialOwnerTool, RAPublicFilingsTool, RAGovernmentIndicatorsTool, RASpecialEventsTool, and RAESGTool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to D&B Risk Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to D&B Risk Analytics in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does D&B Risk Analytics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: D&B Risk Analytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
D&B Risk Analytics is developed by Dun & Bradstreet. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
